messages.subject: legend of strip (facet) in histogram
parts:
Dear All,

I have a example as follows:

DF <- data.frame(group = factor(rep(1:3, each = 100)),
                 weight = c(rnorm(100, 40, 5), rnorm(100, 55, 8),
                            rnorm(100, 75, 10)))
library('ggplot2')
ggplot(DF, aes(x = weight)) +
   geom_histogram(binwidth=5, colour="black", fill="white") +
   facet_grid(group~.) +
   opts(strip.text.y = theme_text(size = 15, angle = -90))

which produces a plot as follows:

How can I move the legends of 3 facet, i.e. group number "1", "2" and "3" on the right of the graph, to desired locations (e.g. on top or inside the graphs).

Any help would be much appreciated!

Cheers Trong.

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: legend of strip (facet) in histogram
parts:
Hi:

Try

... + facet_wrap( ~ group, ncol = 1) + ...   in place of facet_grid()

Dennis
